title: Quake III Arena
shortDescription: John Carmack's pure competitive multiplayer arena shooter featuring rocket jumping, railguns, and curved surfaces.
historicalSignificance: Set the enduring gold standard for competitive esports shooters, network netcode, and blistering movement physics.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
